urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to audit, one per line. Domains without a scheme get https://.

formFactor.title: Device
formFactor.description: 'Both' runs and charges two audits per URL.

saveHtmlReport.title: Save full HTML report
saveHtmlReport.description: Store the complete interactive Lighthouse report for each audit in the key-value store and link it from the results.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel Chrome instances
maxConcurrency.description: More instances = faster, but scores get noisier (CPU contention). Give the run about 2 GB of memory per instance.

timeoutSecs.title: Page load timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Maximum time Lighthouse waits for a page to load before the audit fails.
